title: GUARD (fixed in e6561b26f5) — was: `compset -q` on `"a 'b c` dropped the inner quote of the other kind (and an escaped quote) from $PREFIX and $words

spec.completer:
#compdef fzcq

local -a h
compset -q && h+=(q1)
compadd -x "PRE=$PREFIX|SUF=$SUFFIX|IPRE=$IPREFIX|ISUF=$ISUFFIX|QIPRE=$QIPREFIX|QISUF=$QISUFFIX|CUR=$CURRENT|W=${(j:|:)words}|H=${(j:,:)h}"
compadd -U -- xa yb
compstate[insert]=; compstate[list]=list

observed.notes: Src/Zle/compcore.c set_comp_sep runs untokenize (Src/exec.c, the ztokens mapping) on s (c:1476), ts (c:1735), the new $PREFIX/$SUFFIX (c:1897-1906) and $words (c:1929). A lexed Snull/Dnull/Bnull inside the word comes back as the ' " \ the user typed, so zsh shows PRE=b c W=a|'b c for `"a 'b c`.

observed_when_diverging.recorded_under: main at a41a59a796 (before e6561b26f5), target/debug/zshrs, lane-5 scratch grid cell q1l_11 (completer identical, command name fzp). Only the PRE/W fields were kept from that run; the full row text was not saved. Same grid: `'a"b c` gave zsh PRE=a"b c, zshrs PRE=ab c; 24 of 80 grid cells failed, all with an inner other-kind or escaped quote.

retired.why: set_comp_sep calls untokenize_ztokens (the ztokens mapping) at the c:1476, c:1735, c:1897-1906 and c:1929 sites instead of the marker-stripping untokenize.
